mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dodo_rank_config WHERE store_id = #{storeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_rank_config SET version = version + 1 WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE dodo_rank_config SET homepage_background_image = #{image,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dodo_theme_top_list WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 1 AND is_prod = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id DESC

SELECT t.*, b.id AS board_id FROM dodo_rank_tag t LEFT JOIN dodo_rank_tag_board r ON r.tag_id = t.id AND r.store_id = t.store_id LEFT JOIN dodo_theme_top_list b ON b.id = r.board_id AND b.store_id = t.store_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE t.store_id = #{storeId} AND t.enabled = 1 ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id DESC, b.sort_order, b.id DESC

SELECT r.board_id FROM dodo_rank_tag_board r JOIN dodo_theme_top_list b ON b.id = r.board_id AND b.store_id = r.store_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY sort_order, id DESC) AS board_rank FROM dodo_theme_top_goods_ref r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY sort_order, id DESC) AS board_rank FROM dodo_theme_top_goods_ref r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.parent_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY board_rank

SELECT ranked.* FROM () ranked JOIN dodo_theme_top_list b ON b.id = ranked.parent_id AND b.store_id = #{storeId} WHERE b.status = 1 AND b.is_prod = 1 AND b.association_priority > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_goods g WHERE g.goods_id = ranked.goods_id AND g.store_id = #{storeId} AND g.status = 1 AND g.is_delete = 0 AND g.goods_sn = ranked.goods_sn) AND ranked.goods_id IN #{goodsId} ORDER BY b.association_priority, b.id DESC, ranked.board_rank
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dodo_goods WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} AND goods_sn = #{goodsSn} AND status = 1 AND is_delete = 0

SELECT r.id AS refId, b.id AS boardId, b.title AS boardTitle, r.goods_id AS goodsId, r.goods_sn AS goodsSn, CASE WHEN g.goods_id IS NULL THEN '商品不存在或不属于当前门店' WHEN g.status IS NULL OR g.status != 1 THEN '商品已停用' WHEN g.is_delete IS NULL OR g.is_delete != 0 THEN '商品已删除' ELSE 'SKU为空或与商品不匹配' END AS reason FROM dodo_theme_top_goods_ref r JOIN dodo_theme_top_list b ON b.id = r.parent_id AND b.store_id = r.store_id AND b.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dodo_goods g ON g.goods_id = r.goods_id AND g.store_id = r.store_id WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_goods valid WHERE valid.goods_id = r.goods_id AND valid.store_id = r.store_id AND valid.goods_sn = r.goods_sn AND valid.status = 1 AND valid.is_delete = 0) ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.id DESC, r.sort_order, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_theme_top_goods_ref SET status = 0 WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND id = #{refId} AND status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_theme_top_list b WHERE b.id = parent_id AND b.store_id = #{storeId} AND b.status = 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_goods g WHERE g.goods_id = dodo_theme_top_goods_ref.goods_id AND g.store_id = #{storeId} AND g.goods_sn = dodo_theme_top_goods_ref.goods_sn AND g.status = 1 AND g.is_delete = 0)

UPDATE dodo_theme_top_list SET goods_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dodo_theme_top_goods_ref r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.parent_id = #{boardId} AND r.status = 1) WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND id = #{boardId} AND status = 1

UPDATE dodo_theme_top_list SET is_prod = 0, recommend_position = NULL WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND id = #{boardId} AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dodo_theme_top_goods_ref r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.parent_id = #{boardId} AND r.status = 1)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dodo_rank_tag WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_rank_tag_board (store_id, tag_id, board_id) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{tagId}, #{boardId})
